about: Gander is a town in central Newfoundland on the Trans-Canada Highway, built around Gander International Airport—famous for wartime ferry flights and for sheltering diverted airliners after September 11, 2001. A planned mid-century townsite, aviation museums, and nearby Gander Lake define the community. About 12,000 people live in Gander.
